get.summary: List Portal Groups Created By Me

get.description: Returns all devices registered to the authenticated user, including platform, active status, and last usage timestamp. Public keys are never returned.

delete.description: Revokes a registered device, preventing it from authenticating in the future. Users can only revoke their own devices. All pending unused challenges for the device are also invalidated.

post.description: Binds a device's public key (RSA-2048 or EC P-256, DER base64-encoded) to the authenticated user. The private key must remain in the Android Keystore or iOS Secure Enclave and must never be sent to this API.

Issues a cryptographically secure random challenge for the specified device. The challenge expires in 60 seconds and is single-use. The Flutter client must sign this challenge using the private key stored in Android Keystore / iOS Secure Enclave after biometric authentication.

Verifies the device's digital signature over the challenge. On success, returns the access token for the authenticated session. This endpoint NEVER receives biometric data, face images, or private keys. Only the cryptographic signature produced by Android Keystore / iOS Secure Enclave after biometric authentication is accepted.
